report.title: Exact vs. approximate nearest-neighbour search
report.description: CLIP ViT-B/32 (512-d, inner product on L2-normalised vectors). Queries: 5,000 Flickr30k test captions. CPU, FAISS 1.15.1, 12 OpenMP threads. Index MB = serialised FAISS index (PQ codes are 32 bytes/vector vs 2,048 for float32). The embedded Qdrant mode is exact brute force in Python and is shown only to validate the backend, not as a Qdrant server benchmark. Recall and latency are measured with k=10; 'Task R@K' (is the annotated image retrieved?) comes from a separate depth-100 search, for which HNSW uses efSearch >= 100.
